title: Cradle Shrine

steps.prompt: A small wayside shrine: a waist-high thick-walled pale cream stone egg with a large round opening in the front showing a solid green moss cushion inside, standing on a flat ring of grey stones, chunky solid shapes, no glow. A single object alone, centred, whole object in frame with margin, three-quarter view from slightly above, plain flat white background, even shadowless lighting, no ground, no hands, no extra objects. High-end anime fantasy RPG key visual, stylised 3D look with painterly textures, soft cel shading with warm bounce light and cool rim light, detailed ornate equipment with engraved metal, layered cloth and leather, realistic proportions, expressive anime faces, lush bright colours with luminous highlights, original design, no photorealism, no text, no watermark, no logo.

steps.version: trellis_2_bf16 with shape and texture VAEs and dino_v3_vit_l (Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2), BiRefNet background removal inside the workflow, ComfyUI 0.39.0 built-in nodes

cleanup: Automatic only, by tools/pipeline/blender_finish_model.py: stood upright, welded, decimated to 8000 triangles, smart UV unwrap, vertex colours baked to a 2048 px texture, scaled so the longest side is 1.2 m, origin at the centre of the base.
notes: Input image: stylekit/golden/f1/con_prp_cradle_b.png. The concept image went through TRELLIS.2 (BiRefNet cut-out, shape, texture, remesh, reduce to about 40,000 triangles, unwrap, bake), then Blender reduced it to the budget and re-baked the texture. Measured: source_tris=7892 final_tris=7892 dims=1.170x1.159x1.200 tex=2048. Made with TRELLIS.2 at the coarse remesh setting (192), which keeps spiky, furry and thatched shapes whole. Judged from a rendered preview only; not yet seen in the headset.
